content.comment_body: Is it possible to read the current GPS speed from the [product_name] module (in km/h) and send it to the [product_name]? Thanks.
As far as I know, there is no GPS speed evaluation feature in the [product_name] module. Therefore, it cannot be transmitted to the [product_name] base module.

analysis.insight_summary: A user asked about accessing live GPS speed from a [product_name] module and transferring it to another [product_name] module. It was clarified that GPS speed evaluation is not available in the [product_name] module, so direct data transfer for this purpose is not possible.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expected the [product_name] communication module to allow extraction and direct transfer of real-time GPS speed data to a [product_name] module.
